description: The ticket store the other system plugins write into: the engine's own kanban, the Pipeline and Tasks pages over it, and the dispatcher that turns a client request into a ticket
client_copy: El tablero donde ves en qué está trabajando tu equipo y cómo va cada pedido.
_comment: THE ROOT OF THE SYSTEM GRAPH, AND THE ONE PLUGIN WITH NO SKILLS SURFACE.
There is no SKILL.md to ship because there is nothing to teach: the store
is the ENGINE's (the `kanban` toolset, `hermes kanban ...`, the sqlite the
adapter reads with PRAGMA query_only), and the screens are the portal's own
pages against /portal/boards and /portal/tickets, which the adapter has
served since long before anybody said the word plugin.
SO WHAT THIS MANIFEST IS FOR: the dependency. approval, deliverable,
artifact and flow all write into a TICKET -- the approval skill tells the
agent to ask for it IN the ticket it is working -- so the graph says it out
loud and the build refuses a role that carries one of them without this.
`adapter` stays absent in phase 2 on purpose: declaring it would mean
moving adapter/kanban.py into this folder, and this phase does not touch
the install layout (notes/plugin-system-plan.md). Manifests over the code
that is already there, nothing else.
